observations: Full detail in payload.observations[]. This run completed the ENTIRE investigation checklist for store2 (SDK v2): initial localStorage state, per-field write timing across all observed field kinds (template radio, simple clipart, grouped_clipart with nested child selection, and text), reload/restore behavior, full add-to-cart, and post-ATC + post-cleanup localStorage state -- the last two of which store1 could not test because it intentionally stopped before ATC.

First attempt at this run's Add-to-cart hit a genuine validation error ('This field is required!') because grouped_clipart fields (Hairstyle, Cat Breed #1, Cat Breed #2) require a TWO-STEP selection: clicking the group radio (e.g. 'Black') reveals a required nested sub-field of specific clipart-variant thumbnails ('tee-field--<id>-children') that must ALSO be clicked before the field is considered filled. This was discovered by inspecting the DOM after the failed attempt and is reported as OBSERVED_CURRENT storefront UI behavior, not assumed from the task's prior success claim for store2.
unknowns: Exact intermediate localStorage state between clicking a grouped_clipart field's GROUP radio alone (before the child/sub-variant click) was not isolated as a separate read -- the two clicks were performed within the same ~600ms window before each dump, so whether the group click alone writes a placeholder value (e.g. the group's plain '5995') that is then overwritten by the child's asset-path value, or whether no write happens until the child is chosen, is NOT_OBSERVED at that granularity.

Whether the field-level 'restore on remount' behavior (LS-SNAP-08: a text field remounted via a parent re-selection pre-fills from teeinblue-global-options) applies uniformly to radio/clipart-type fields too, or only to text-type fields -- this run only directly confirmed it for the Woman Name text field. The grouped_clipart fields were re-clicked from scratch on refill rather than checked for pre-existing checked state before the click, so their own remount-restore behavior is unconfirmed.

TTL/expiry: only a last-write 'timestamp' (epoch ms) field is present in both teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options, same as store1. No explicit expiry field and no long-duration wait was performed; NOT_OBSERVED whether entries are ever pruned by age.

Whether the backend call observed at Add-to-cart time (POST https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/merchant/shopify/customization?shop=linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com&id=15280333291824, immediately followed by the Shopify /cart/add call) is the sole persistence path, or whether any earlier/partial backend sync also occurs on individual field changes before ATC -- across all field-change checkpoints in this run (steps 02-07), zero XHR/fetch to any teeinblue or non-Shopify-telemetry host was observed, but this is single-session evidence, not exhaustive proof of absence.

Full request/response body contract of the customization POST call above is NOT analyzed here -- handed off as a network_observation_ref to api-explorer per this agent's scope boundary, not treated as a full API contract.

Cross-store comparison (store1 vs store2) here is based on ONE sample field of each kind per store; generalizing 'SDK v1 and v2 share the same global-option-NNN id scheme' beyond the two template variants (template-277843/1 vs template-578330/2) actually clicked is an inference from matching numeric ids observed in both stores' DOM dumps for the SAME underlying campaign 2595, not independently reconfirmed on store1 with template 2.

Both this run's failed-attempt evidence and the eventual successful-attempt evidence are preserved; orchestrator/reviewer should reconcile against CTX-20260912-03's actual interaction log if deeper certainty is needed.

observations.action: Click template thumbnail #2 (field id 4081, value 'template-578330', SAME field id 4081 as store1 despite different product ids -- same underlying campaign 2595). Read localStorage at 300ms and again at 1500ms after the click.
observations.observed_result: Two new keys appear SYNCHRONOUSLY with the click (already present at the 300ms immediate read, unchanged at 1500ms settle -- confirmed sync write, IDENTICAL timing behavior to store1): 'teeinblue-global-options' and 'teeinblue-customizations'. teeinblue-customizations is a JSON string encoding an ARRAY of one object: { productId, customization: { "4081": "template-578330", "global-option-847": <asset path>, platform_linked_id }, timestamp }. teeinblue-global-options is a JSON OBJECT keyed by global-option numeric id, each value shaped { value, extra: {}, timestamp }. Shape is BYTE-FOR-BYTE IDENTICAL in structure to store1 (array-of-one-object for customizations; id-keyed object for global-options; same field names productId/customization/timestamp/value/extra). Selecting the template auto-selected a default skin-tone value (global-option-847) as a side effect, same auto-cascade behavior as store1.
observations.state_after: teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options present, as described

observations.action: Click the 'Choose Woman's Skin Tone' field (global-option-847), a SIMPLE clipart-type field (no nested children) -- single click on a swatch label. Read localStorage after.
observations.observed_result: Value written synchronously on click, same as the template field. Simple clipart-type fields require only ONE click, unlike grouped_clipart fields (see SF-OBS-005).
observations.state_after: global-option-847 value updated to the newly clicked swatch's asset path

observations.action: Click the 'Choose Woman's Hairstyle' field (global-option-848), a grouped_clipart-type field. First inspected the field's DOM before and after clicking only the group-level radio label ('Black').
observations.observed_result: IMPORTANT SDK v2 (and likely v1, untested there) UI mechanism discovered: clicking a grouped_clipart field's group radio (e.g. 'Black', input name=global-option-848, value=5995) DOES mark that radio checked=true, but simultaneously reveals a NEW required nested sub-field (id 'tee-field--layer-224514-children', input name='layer-224514-children') containing ~12 specific clipart-variant thumbnails, NONE pre-selected. The group radio's own plain value (5995) is NOT what ends up stored as the field's final localStorage value -- global-option-848 in teeinblue-customizations/global-options only resolves to a real value (the CHILD's asset path, e.g. '.../6a5dedaf4731d_large.webp') once a child thumbnail is ALSO clicked. Clicking the group alone is therefore INSUFFICIENT to satisfy the field or to produce a stable localStorage write for that field; a first end-to-end fill+ATC attempt that skipped this second click resulted in a real Add-to-cart validation failure (see conflicts[]).
observations.state_before: Hairstyle field showing only 2 group options (Black/Red), neither selected
observations.state_after: Group radio 'Black' checked; nested children sub-field revealed and (after second click) one child selected; global-option-848 written with the child's asset path

evidence_refs.note: First-attempt run log capturing the failure mode and the raw DOM for the children sub-field (script store2-explore-grouped.js console output, folded into this agent's investigation).

observations.action: Type a synthetic (non-real-customer) value into the 'Woman Name' text field (name=global-option-849, maxlength=10, field id 'layer-423618'). Read localStorage mid-typing, immediately after typing while still focused, and after blur.
observations.observed_result: IDENTICAL write-timing behavior to store1: the typed text is NOT written to teeinblue-customizations/teeinblue-global-options while typing or while still focused after typing completes. It is written ONLY on blur. No mid-typing or post-type-pre-blur write was observed at any checkpoint.
observations.state_after: customization gains global-option-849 key with the typed (redacted) value, written at blur

observations.action: Complete the remaining chain: Cat Breed #1 (grouped_clipart, group+child) + Cat Name #1 (text), Cat Breed #2 (grouped_clipart, group+child) + Cat Name #2 (text). Read full localStorage state after all 8 personalization inputs are set.
observations.observed_result: teeinblue-customizations.customization now contains all 8 keys (4081, global-option-843..849, platform_linked_id) and teeinblue-global-options contains keys 843-849 -- same shape family as store1 (array-of-one-object / id-keyed-object), now with a fuller field set than store1 explored (store1 only reached 2 of 8 field kinds). No validation error was present in the DOM text at this point (grouped_clipart child clicks were included this time).

observations.state_after: Full 8-field chain populated in both localStorage keys

observations.action: With the full 8-field chain populated, reload the page (page.reload()). Compare localStorage content and DOM form state before vs. after reload.
observations.observed_result: localStorage keys teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options SURVIVE the reload byte-identical (same JSON string) -- persisted, not cleared, matching store1. The DOM form does NOT restore on full page load: after reload, only the top-level template selector field ('tee-field--4081-template') is present in the DOM, with no option checked; all 7 dependent fields (skin tone, hairstyle, name, 2x breed, 2x cat name) are absent from the DOM entirely, exactly as store1 observed (save-without-restore-on-load).
observations.state_after: Form reset to only the top-level template selector, nothing selected, dependent fields absent from DOM

observations.action: NEW finding beyond store1's scope: after the page-level reload (SF-OBS-008 confirmed no page-load restore), re-select the top-level template on the reloaded page to make the dependent fields reappear, then check the Woman Name text field's value BEFORE typing anything into it.
observations.observed_result: The Woman Name field remounted with its PREVIOUS value already pre-filled (read back from teeinblue-global-options[849], which had survived the reload per SF-OBS-008) -- even though the page itself never auto-restored the form on load. This is a narrower, FIELD-REMOUNT-level restore that only triggers when a dependent field is freshly (re-)rendered by its parent selection, not a page-load restore. This nuance was not tested by store1 (which stopped before reload+refill) and refines rather than contradicts the 'no restore' finding: 'no restore' is accurate for a fresh page load, but re-triggering a field's mount via its parent dependency DOES pull the last-saved value back in.
observations.state_after: Field present, pre-filled with prior value without any typing

observations.action: First Add-to-cart attempt: refill the full 8-field chain on the reloaded page using only single clicks on grouped_clipart group labels (no child-thumbnail click), then click 'Add to cart'.
observations.observed_result: ATC FAILED with a visible page error 'Error: Some fields are required or invalid data', and inline 'This field is required!' text under Hairstyle, Cat Breed #1, and Cat Breed #2. Confirmed via GET /cart.js immediately after: item_count=0, items=[] -- no line item was actually added. This directly contradicts the task input's framing that store2 ATC was already a known-working, previously-solved path; see conflicts[].
observations.state_before: Full chain 'appears' filled (group radios checked) but children sub-fields unset
observations.state_after: Cart unchanged (empty), validation error shown, teeinblue-customizations retained the group-only (no child) values

observations.action: Second Add-to-cart attempt (fresh browser profile, full run repeated from scratch): refill the full 8-field chain INCLUDING the grouped_clipart child-thumbnail click for Hairstyle, Cat Breed #1, and Cat Breed #2, then click 'Add to cart'.
observations.observed_result: ATC SUCCEEDED. No validation error text present. GET /cart.js confirmed item_count=1, total_price=5599 (USD 55.99, matching the base price -- no visible surcharge from the personalization options exercised). Line item properties contained ONLY opaque references -- _customization_id (uuid), _customization_image (a rendered preview JPG URL), _tib_fulfilled_sku, _tib_design_link_1 (a rendered PNG URL) -- NOT the raw personalization field values (no 'Woman Name', 'Cat Name #1' etc. as visible line item properties). The buyer's typed text/choices are NOT exposed in the Shopify cart object; they are pre-rendered server-side into an opaque design/customization record before being attached to the cart line.
observations.state_after: 1 line item in cart, USD 55.99, referencing a server-generated customization id/design image

evidence_refs.note: Cart icon shows quantity 1; PERSONALIZE panel shows all fields correctly filled (template 2, skin tone swatch, Black hairstyle + specific avatar variant, Scottish fold + Long hair breeds, both names filled).

observations.action: NEW finding, store1 could not test this (stopped before ATC): immediately after the successful Add-to-cart in SF-OBS-011, re-read the full localStorage state (all keys, teeinblue-customizations, teeinblue-global-options) and compare byte-for-byte to the pre-ATC state.
observations.observed_result: teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options are BOTH RETAINED, UNCHANGED (byte-identical, same timestamp) after a successful Add-to-cart. Add-to-cart does NOT clear or reset the client-side personalization draft in localStorage -- the draft mechanism appears to be a pure UI-convenience/session-draft store, entirely decoupled from cart lifecycle. This answers the core question this run was newly tasked to investigate (store1 was blocked from reaching this point by design).
observations.state_before: localStorage populated with full 8-field customization, cart empty

observations.action: Cleanup: after confirming the cart item and localStorage state, remove the test line item via POST /cart/clear.js (safe, reversible, test-data-scope action per this run's FULL_MUTATION_WITHIN_OWN_TEST_DATA_SCOPE policy), then verify via GET /cart.js and re-read localStorage once more.
observations.observed_result: Cart successfully emptied (item_count: 0 confirmed via GET /cart.js after clear). teeinblue-customizations and teeinblue-global-options in localStorage remained PRESENT AND UNCHANGED after the cart clear as well -- cart cleanup does not touch the personalization draft either. No checkout, payment, or order was created at any point in this run.
observations.state_before: 1 line item in cart, localStorage populated
observations.state_after: Cart empty (verified), localStorage still populated with the same customization draft

observations.action: During the entire field-fill sequence (template through full 8-field chain, ~9 seconds of interaction), inspect all captured non-static (non-image/font/stylesheet) network requests for any XHR/fetch to a teeinblue-owned or non-Shopify-telemetry host.
observations.observed_result: Zero teeinblue-related XHR/fetch requests occurred during field-filling -- only Shopify's own telemetry/analytics calls (otlp-http-production.shopifysvc.com metrics/logs, monorail-edge.shopifysvc.com, error-analytics-sessions, /api/collect) were seen, consistent with store1's single-sample finding that personalization writes are purely client-side. The FIRST teeinblue-owned network call observed in the entire session was AT Add-to-cart time: POST https://staging-api.teeinblue.com/api/merchant/shopify/customization?shop=linh-explorer-2.myshopify.com&id=15280333291824, immediately followed by the native Shopify POST /cart/add. This confirms server-side customization record creation happens synchronously as part of the Add-to-cart action, not during field-filling.

feature_candidates.candidate: Client-side personalization draft persistence via localStorage (keys 'teeinblue-customizations' and 'teeinblue-global-options'), SDK v2 / store2
feature_candidates.note: Confirmed to exist under the SAME key names and SAME shape (array-of-one-object customizations / id-keyed global-options) as store1 (SDK v1). Mechanism is shared/consistent across both SDK versions on this campaign, with three refinements only surfaced in this run: (1) grouped_clipart fields need a group+child two-step interaction to actually write a value, (2) a field remounted via its parent selection pulls its own last value back from localStorage even though a full page load does not, (3) the draft is untouched by both a successful Add-to-cart and a subsequent cart clear.
